title: Guarded Post-Success Cleanup

todos.content: Add --clean-work CLI flag defaulting to false
todos.outcome: Parser tests prove --clean-work is accepted and defaults to false

todos.content: Run cleanup only after a batch subprocess exits successfully
todos.outcome: Tests prove cleanup is called after returncode 0 and not called after non-zero returncode

todos.content: Implement cleanup sequence using nextflow clean first and guarded direct deletion fallback for exact batch work dir only
todos.outcome: Cleanup helper refuses targets outside work root or without expected batch_### component and only deletes validated batch work dirs

todos.content: Add path-safety tests for cleanup guard rejection cases
todos.outcome: Tests cover outside-root, non-batch, failed-batch, and successful-batch cleanup paths

todos.content: Run focused cleanup and CLI tests
todos.outcome: Focused pytest invocation for cleanup-related tests exits 0

notes: Preserve flat final outputs under params.output_dir; do not introduce batched output directories.
Batch identity belongs only in per-batch work dirs, per-batch params snapshots, and traces/reports/timelines.
Oversized single plate guard is intentionally deferred.
Guarded deletion of per-batch work dirs after successful batch completion is now implemented.
The worker should execute this loop inline without spawning subagents.
constraints: Do not add batched output directories.
Keep output locations batch-scoped only for work dirs, params snapshots, traces, reports, and timelines.
Leave the oversized single plate guard deferred.

handoff_injected.done: Loop 360 implemented configurable scratch sizing in batch.py and CLI wiring. create_batches now accepts utilisation_fraction and work_factor with defaults preserving current behavior. Config keys scratch_utilisation_fraction and scratch_work_factor are parsed and validated before batch creation, forwarded into scratch batch planning, and shown in dry-run output. Focused tests in tests/test_batch.py and tests/test_cli.py cover defaults, overrides, invalid values, and dry-run reporting.
handoff_injected.needed: Loop 370 can now add guarded cleanup on top of the validated batch work-dir model.
